title: Helm chart render checks in CI via helm.yml render() helper
answers: how to test helm chart template rendering in CI
how to assert a helm value renders into deployment.yaml
how to check a field is omitted by default in the mlflow chart
helm template grep assertion workflow step
body:
The render check lives in .github/workflows/helm.yml as steps named "Render ...". Each step defines render() as: helm template mlflow charts/ --set mlflow.backendStoreUri="sqlite:////tmp/mlflow.db" "$@" -s templates/deployment.yaml.
mlflow.backendStoreUri must be set or the render fails, so keep it in the helper rather than each call.
-s templates/deployment.yaml limits output to the Deployment, so greps do not match other templates.
To assert omission, use render | grep -q '<key>:' inside an if and exit 1 on match.
To assert rendering, pass --set 'list[0].field=value' flags and grep for exact indented lines (for example '^          maxSkew: 1'). The indentation comes from nindent in the template, so update the patterns if the nindent changes.
applies: Adding or changing chart template behaviour in charts/templates/deployment.yaml.
